source.text: Παῦλος ἀπόστολος Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ διὰ θελήματος θεοῦ τοῖς ἁγίοις τοῖς οὖσιν ἐν Ἐφέσῳ καὶ πιστοῖς ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ·

records.literal_gloss: Paul, apostle of Christ Jesus through [the] will of God, to the holy [ones] the [ones] being in Ephesus and faithful in Christ Jesus:

en.L: Paul, an apostle of {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} Jesus through [the] will of God, to the holy ones who are in Ephesus and faithful in {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} Jesus:
en.B: From Paul, an apostle of {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus by the will of God, to God's holy people in Ephesus, who are faithful in {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus.
en.R: This letter is from Paul. It was God's will that I should be an apostle, sent out by {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus. I am writing to God's holy people in Ephesus, who belong to {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus and are faithful to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

es.L: Pablo, apóstol {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}} Jesús por [la] voluntad de Dios, a los santos que están en Éfeso y fieles en {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}} Jesús:
es.B: De Pablo, apóstol {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}} Jesús por la voluntad de Dios, al pueblo santo de Dios en Éfeso, que es fiel en {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} Jesús.
es.R: Esta carta es de Pablo. Dios quiso que yo fuera apóstol, enviado por {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} Jesús. Escribo al pueblo santo de Dios en Éfeso, que pertenece {{christos:a Cristo|al Mesías}} Jesús y es fiel a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.

sw.L: Paulo, mtume wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu kupitia mapenzi ya Mungu, kwa watakatifu walioko Efeso na waaminifu katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu:
sw.B: Kutoka kwa Paulo, mtume wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu kwa mapenzi ya Mungu, kwa watu wa Mungu walio watakatifu huko Efeso, walio waaminifu katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu.
sw.R: Barua hii inatoka kwa Paulo. Mungu alitaka niwe mtume, niliyetumwa na {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu. Ninawaandikia watu wa Mungu walio watakatifu huko Efeso, ambao ni mali ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Yesu na ni waaminifu {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}.

fr.L: Paul, apôtre du {{christos:Christ|Messie}} Jésus par la volonté de Dieu, aux saints qui sont à Éphèse et fidèles {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}} Jésus :
fr.B: De la part de Paul, apôtre du {{christos:Christ|Messie}} Jésus par la volonté de Dieu, au peuple saint de Dieu qui est à Éphèse, fidèle {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}} Jésus.
fr.R: Cette lettre vient de Paul. Dieu a voulu que je sois apôtre, envoyé par le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} Jésus. J’écris au peuple saint de Dieu à Éphèse, à ceux qui appartiennent au {{christos:Christ|Messie}} Jésus et qui {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} sont fidèles.

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: "in Ephesus"
alternatives: leave out "in Ephesus": "to the holy ones who are also faithful in Christ Jesus"
decisions.reason: Some of the earliest manuscripts, among them P46 and the first hands of Codex Sinaiticus and Codex Vaticanus, do not have ἐν Ἐφέσῳ; almost all later manuscripts do. Without the place name the Greek is awkward ("to the holy ones who are and faithful"). The letter has no personal greetings and speaks of the readers' faith as something Paul has heard about (1:15; 3:2), so it may have been written for several churches in the province of Asia, with Ephesus as its chief city. Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: apostle: a messenger sent out with the authority of the one who sends him
alternatives: a missionary or church worker in general
decisions.reason: As in Colossians 1:1: ἀπόστολος means one who is sent, and Paul counts himself among those commissioned by the risen Christ (1 Corinthians 15:7-9; Galatians 1:1). He holds the role "through the will of God".

decisions.choice: faithful: loyal and true to Christ; the same people as the holy ones
alternatives: a second, smaller group within the church
decisions.reason: πιστοῖς can mean "believing" or "faithful". "Holy" and "faithful" describe one group, the whole church, as in Colossians 1:2. The letter takes their faith for granted (1:15) and urges them to stay true (4:1; 6:10-13).

decisions.choice: Ephesus: the leading city of the Roman province of Asia, a port on the west coast of what is now Turkey
decisions.reason: The city was famous for its great temple of Artemis (Acts 19:27-35). Paul worked there for over two years (Acts 19:8-10; 20:31).

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} Jesus (L); {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus (B, R)
decisions.reason: Title setting.

decisions.choice: God's holy people
decisions.reason: As in Colossians 1:2 and Philippians 1:1: in current English "saints" suggests unusually good people, not a whole congregation.

decisions.choice: It was God's will that I should be an apostle, sent out by {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus; who belong to {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} Jesus and are faithful to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}
alternatives: an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God; faithful in Christ Jesus
decisions.reason: Readable says what an apostle is, as Colossians 1:1 does, and spells out "faithful in Christ Jesus": they are joined to him and loyal to him (m3).

decisions.choice: deity_pronoun spans only on free pronouns and possessives (kwake, yake, wake, zake, yeye)
alternatives: a span on every pronoun the English marks
decisions.reason: Swahili marks most pronouns inside the verb (a-li-tu-chagua), and a prefix cannot take a capital. So in this chapter the setting applies to free words such as "ndani yake", "utukufu wake", "nguvu zake" and "waaminifu kwake", and Swahili has fewer spans than the English.

decisions.choice: "du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}", "le {{christos:Christ|Messie}}", "au {{christos:Christ|Messie}}"; "{{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}}" for Paul's "in Christ" (for the whole letter)
alternatives: {{christos:Christ|Messie}} with the article inside the span
decisions.reason: As in Colossians: French cannot say "en Messie", because the title needs an article and "en" does not take one, so the span for "in Christ" covers the preposition, with the familiar "en Christ" as the default. Elsewhere the article stays outside the span, since both "le Christ" and "le Messie" are good French.

decisions.choice: passé composé for past events at every level (for the whole letter)
decisions.reason: Ephesians is a letter: Paul tells the readers what God has done for them and what they heard and received, and French uses the passé composé for that ("Dieu nous a choisis", "vous avez entendu"), as in Colossians. The letter has no narrative that would call for the passé simple.

decisions.choice: aux saints (L); au peuple saint de Dieu (B); au peuple saint de Dieu, au peuple de Dieu (R) (for the whole letter)
decisions.reason: As in Colossians and as in the English: in current French "les saints" suggests people of exceptional goodness or those canonized by the church, not a whole congregation. Literal keeps the word so the reader can follow it.

source.text: χάρις ὑμῖν καὶ εἰρήνη ἀπὸ θεοῦ πατρὸς ἡμῶν καὶ κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: Grace to you and peace from God Father of us and Lord Jesus Christ.

en.L: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and [the] Lord Jesus {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}.
en.B: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}.
en.R: May God our Father and the Lord Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} show you grace and give you peace.

es.L: Gracia a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} y paz de Dios nuestro Padre y [del] Señor Jesús {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}}.
es.B: Gracia y paz a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} de parte de Dios nuestro Padre y del Señor Jesús {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}}.
es.R: Que Dios nuestro Padre y el Señor Jesús {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} {{plural_you:les|os}} den gracia y paz.

sw.L: Neema kwenu na amani kutoka kwa Mungu Baba yetu na Bwana Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}.
sw.B: Neema na amani kutoka kwa Mungu Baba yetu na kwa Bwana Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} ziwe pamoja nanyi.
sw.R: Mungu Baba yetu na Bwana Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} wawaonyeshe ninyi neema na wawape amani.

fr.L: Grâce à vous et paix de la part de Dieu notre Père et du Seigneur Jésus {{christos:Christ|Messie}}.
fr.B: Grâce et paix à vous de la part de Dieu notre Père et du Seigneur Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}}.
fr.R: Que Dieu notre Père et le Seigneur Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}} vous donnent la grâce et la paix.

decisions.choice: grace and peace: God's free kindness, and the wholeness and well-being he gives
alternatives: an ordinary letter greeting with no special weight
decisions.reason: Greek letters opened with a word of greeting from the same root as χάρις; Paul makes it a prayer for God's grace, and adds εἰρήνη, which stands for the Hebrew greeting shalom, the full well-being God gives. Both words return in the letter (2:5-8; 2:14-17).

decisions.choice: one source: God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ together
alternatives: two separate sources of two separate gifts
decisions.reason: One preposition, ἀπὸ, governs both names, so the Father and the Lord Jesus are named together as the one source of grace and peace, as in Paul's other greetings (Romans 1:7; Philippians 1:2).

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} (L); {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: Title setting.

decisions.choice: May God our Father and the Lord Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} show you grace and give you peace
alternatives: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ
decisions.reason: Readable makes the greeting a prayer, as Colossians 1:2 and Philippians 1:2 do.

decisions.choice: ustedes / vosotros forms (for the whole letter)
decisions.reason: Paul writes to the church in the plural. Every plural "you" and its verb is a reader setting: ustedes (Latin America, the default) or vosotros (Spain), as in Philippians 4.

source.text: Εὐλογητὸς ὁ θεὸς καὶ πατὴρ τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, ὁ εὐλογήσας ἡμᾶς ἐν πάσῃ εὐλογίᾳ πνευματικῇ ἐν τοῖς ἐπουρανίοις ἐν Χριστῷ, καθὼς ἐξελέξατο ἡμᾶς ἐν αὐτῷ πρὸ καταβολῆς κόσμου, εἶναι ἡμᾶς ἁγίους καὶ ἀμώμους κατενώπιον αὐτοῦ ἐν ἀγάπῃ, προορίσας ἡμᾶς εἰς υἱοθεσίαν διὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ εἰς αὐτόν, κατὰ τὴν εὐδοκίαν τοῦ θελήματος αὐτοῦ, εἰς ἔπαινον δόξης τῆς χάριτος αὐτοῦ ἧς ἐχαρίτωσεν ἡμᾶς ἐν τῷ ἠγαπημένῳ, ἐν ᾧ ἔχομεν τὴν ἀπολύτρωσιν διὰ τοῦ αἵματος αὐτοῦ, τὴν ἄφεσιν τῶν παραπτωμάτων, κατὰ τὸ πλοῦτος τῆς χάριτος αὐτοῦ ἧς ἐπερίσσευσεν εἰς ἡμᾶς ἐν πάσῃ σοφίᾳ καὶ φρονήσει γνωρίσας ἡμῖν τὸ μυστήριον τοῦ θελήματος αὐτοῦ, κατὰ τὴν εὐδοκίαν αὐτοῦ ἣν προέθετο ἐν αὐτῷ εἰς οἰκονομίαν τοῦ πληρώματος τῶν καιρῶν, ἀνακεφαλαιώσασθαι τὰ πάντα ἐν τῷ Χριστῷ, τὰ ἐπὶ τοῖς οὐρανοῖς καὶ τὰ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς· ἐν αὐτῷ, ἐν ᾧ καὶ ἐκληρώθημεν προορισθέντες κατὰ πρόθεσιν τοῦ τὰ πάντα ἐνεργοῦντος κατὰ τὴν βουλὴν τοῦ θελήματος αὐτοῦ, εἰς τὸ εἶναι ἡμᾶς εἰς ἔπαινον δόξης αὐτοῦ τοὺς προηλπικότας ἐν τῷ Χριστῷ·

records.literal_gloss: Blessed [be] the God and Father of the Lord of us Jesus Christ, the [one] having blessed us in every blessing spiritual in the heavenly [places] in Christ, \v 4 just as he chose us in him before [the] foundation of [the] world, to be us holy and blameless before him in love, \v 5 having predestined us to adoption-as-sons through Jesus Christ to him, according to the good pleasure of the will of him, \v 6 to [the] praise of [the] glory of the grace of him, which he graced us in the [one] having been loved, \v 7 in whom we have the redemption through the blood of him, the forgiveness of the trespasses, according to the riches of the grace of him, \v 8 which he made abound to us in all wisdom and insight, \v 9 having made known to us the mystery of the will of him, according to the good pleasure of him, which he purposed in him \v 10 for [the] administration of the fullness of the times, to sum up the all things in the Christ, the [things] on the heavens and the [things] on the earth; in him, \v 11 in whom also we were allotted, having been predestined according to [the] purpose of the [one] the all things working according to the counsel of the will of him, \v 12 for the to be us for [the] praise of glory of him, the [ones] having hoped-before in the Christ;

en.L: Blessed [be] the God and Father of our Lord Jesus {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}, who has blessed us with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly [places] in {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}, \v 4 just as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} chose us in {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} before [the] foundation of [the] world, that we should be holy and blameless before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} in love, \v 5 having predestined us for adoption as {{gender:sons and daughters|sons}} through Jesus {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} to {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}}, according to the good pleasure of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} will, \v 6 to [the] praise of [the] glory of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} grace, with which {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} graced us in the Beloved, \v 7 in whom we have the redemption through {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} blood, the forgiveness of trespasses, according to the riches of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} grace, \v 8 which {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} made abound toward us in all wisdom and insight, \v 9 having made known to us the mystery of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} will, according to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} good pleasure, which {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} purposed in {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} \v 10 for [the] administration of the fullness of the times: to sum up all things in the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}, the things in the heavens and the things on the earth, in {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, \v 11 in whom also we were made [God's] inheritance, having been predestined according to [the] purpose of the [one] who works all things according to the counsel of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} will, \v 12 so that we, who had first hoped in the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}, should be to [the] praise of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} glory;
en.B: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}. In {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has blessed us with every blessing the Spirit gives in the heavenly places. \v 4 Even before the world was founded, God chose us in {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, so that we would be holy and without blemish before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} in love. \v 5 He marked us out beforehand to be adopted as {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own {{gender:sons and daughters|sons}} through Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}. That was what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gladly willed, \v 6 so that {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} glorious grace would be praised, the grace {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has freely given us in the Beloved. \v 7 In {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and through {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} blood we have redemption, the forgiveness of our wrongdoing. We have it because God's grace is so rich, \v 8 grace that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has poured out on us in abundance, with all wisdom and understanding. \v 9 He has made known to us the mystery of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} will, as it pleased {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to do. He set out this purpose in {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} \v 10 as {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} plan for when the times reach their fullness: to bring all things together under one head in {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, things in heaven and things on earth, all in {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. \v 11 In {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} we too have been claimed as God's own portion. We were marked out for this beforehand by the purpose of God, who works out everything as {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} will determines, \v 12 so that we who were the first to hope in {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} would bring praise to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} glory.
en.R: Praise the God and Father of our Lord Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}! Because we are joined to {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, God has blessed us with every blessing the Spirit brings, blessings from the heavenly world. \v 4 Even before {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} made the world, God chose us to be joined to {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}. He chose us to be holy and without fault in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} sight, and to live in love. \v 5 Long ago God decided to adopt us through Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} as {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own {{gender:sons and daughters|sons}}, with all the rights of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} children. That is what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} wanted, and it gave {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} joy. \v 6 He did this so that {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} glorious grace would be praised. He has given us this grace freely in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} dearly loved Son. \v 7 Through the blood of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} Son we have been set free, and our wrongs are forgiven. That is how rich God's grace is, \v 8 and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has poured it out on us in full measure. He has given us all wisdom and understanding. \v 9 He has let us know the mystery of what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} wanted to do: {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} plan, once hidden, now made known. God was glad to make this plan, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} made it to be carried out through {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}. \v 10 This is God's plan for the time {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has set: to bring everything in heaven and on earth together, with {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} as head over them all. \v 11 Because we are joined to {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, God has made us {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own people, {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} treasured share. He decided this long before. God makes everything happen the way {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has planned and willed. \v 12 He did this so that we, who were the first to put our hope in {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, would bring praise to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} glory.

es.L: Bendito [sea] el Dios y Padre de nuestro Señor Jesús {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}}, que nos ha bendecido con toda bendición espiritual en los [lugares] celestiales en {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}}, \v 4 así como nos eligió en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} antes de [la] fundación del mundo, para que fuéramos santos y sin mancha delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} en amor, \v 5 habiéndonos predestinado para adopción como hijos por medio de Jesús {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}} para {{deity_pronoun:sí mismo|Sí mismo}}, según el beneplácito de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} voluntad, \v 6 para alabanza de [la] gloria de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gracia, con la cual nos agració en el Amado, \v 7 en quien tenemos la redención por medio de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} sangre, el perdón de [las] transgresiones, según las riquezas de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gracia, \v 8 que hizo abundar hacia nosotros en toda sabiduría y entendimiento, \v 9 dándonos a conocer el misterio de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} voluntad, según {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} beneplácito, que se propuso en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} \v 10 para [la] administración de la plenitud de los tiempos: reunir todas las cosas en el {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}}, las [cosas] en los cielos y las [cosas] sobre la tierra, en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, \v 11 en quien también fuimos hechos herencia [de Dios], habiendo sido predestinados según [el] propósito del que realiza todas las cosas según el consejo de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} voluntad, \v 12 a fin de que nosotros, los que antes hemos esperado en el {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}}, seamos para alabanza de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gloria;
es.B: Bendito sea el Dios y Padre de nuestro Señor Jesús {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}}. En {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} nos ha bendecido con toda bendición que da el Espíritu en los lugares celestiales. \v 4 Antes de que el mundo fuera fundado, Dios nos eligió en {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} para que fuéramos santos y sin mancha delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} en amor. \v 5 De antemano nos destinó a ser adoptados como {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} propios hijos por medio de Jesús {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}}. Eso fue lo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} quiso con agrado, \v 6 para que fuera alabada {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gloriosa gracia, la gracia que nos ha dado gratuitamente en el Amado. \v 7 En {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} y por medio de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} sangre tenemos la redención, el perdón de nuestras faltas. La tenemos porque la gracia de Dios es muy rica, \v 8 gracia que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha derramado sobre nosotros en abundancia, con toda sabiduría y entendimiento. \v 9 Nos ha dado a conocer el misterio de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} voluntad, como a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} le agradó hacerlo. Se propuso este plan en {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} \v 10 como {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} designio para cuando los tiempos llegaran a su plenitud: reunir todas las cosas bajo una sola cabeza en {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}}, las que están en el cielo y las que están en la tierra, todo en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. \v 11 En {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} también nosotros hemos llegado a ser la porción propia de Dios. Para esto fuimos destinados de antemano por el propósito de Dios, que lo lleva a cabo todo como {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} voluntad lo determina, \v 12 para que nosotros, los primeros en poner nuestra esperanza en {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}}, seamos para alabanza de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gloria.
es.R: ¡Alabemos al Dios y Padre de nuestro Señor Jesús {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}}! Porque estamos unidos {{christos:a Cristo|al Mesías}}, Dios nos ha bendecido con toda bendición que trae el Espíritu, bendiciones del mundo celestial. \v 4 Aun antes de crear el mundo, Dios nos eligió para que estuviéramos unidos {{christos:a Cristo|al Mesías}}. Nos eligió para que fuéramos santos y sin falta ante {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} ojos, y para que viviéramos en amor. \v 5 Hace mucho tiempo Dios decidió adoptarnos por medio de Jesús {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} como {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} propios hijos, con todos los derechos que tienen los hijos. Eso es lo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} quería, y eso {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} dio alegría. \v 6 Lo hizo para que {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gloriosa gracia fuera alabada. Nos ha dado esta gracia gratuitamente en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} Hijo amado. \v 7 Por la sangre de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} Hijo hemos sido liberados, y nuestras malas acciones están perdonadas. Así de rica es la gracia de Dios, \v 8 y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} la ha derramado sobre nosotros en abundancia. Nos ha dado toda sabiduría y entendimiento. \v 9 Nos ha dejado conocer el misterio de lo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} quería hacer: {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} plan, antes escondido, ahora dado a conocer. A Dios le alegró hacer este plan, y lo hizo para llevarlo a cabo por medio {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}. \v 10 Este es el plan de Dios para el tiempo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha fijado: reunir todo lo que hay en el cielo y en la tierra, con {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} como cabeza de todo. \v 11 Porque estamos unidos {{christos:a Cristo|al Mesías}}, Dios nos ha hecho {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} propio pueblo, {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} porción preciosa. Lo decidió hace mucho tiempo. Dios hace que todo suceda como {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} lo ha planeado y querido. \v 12 Lo hizo para que nosotros, los primeros en poner nuestra esperanza en {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}}, diéramos alabanza a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gloria.

sw.L: Abarikiwe Mungu na Baba wa Bwana wetu Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, aliyetubariki kwa kila baraka ya kiroho katika [mahali pa] mbinguni katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, \v 4 kama alivyotuchagua ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kabla ya kuwekwa misingi ya ulimwengu, ili tuwe watakatifu na bila lawama mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} katika upendo, \v 5 akiisha kutuamulia tangu awali tufanywe wana kupitia Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}}, kulingana na radhi ya mapenzi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, \v 6 kwa sifa ya utukufu wa neema {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, ambayo alituneemesha nayo katika Mpendwa, \v 7 ambaye ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} tuna ukombozi kupitia damu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, msamaha wa makosa, kulingana na utajiri wa neema {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, \v 8 aliyoizidisha kwetu katika hekima yote na ufahamu, \v 9 akiisha kutufahamisha siri ya mapenzi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, kulingana na radhi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, aliyoikusudia ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} \v 10 kwa mpango wa utimilifu wa nyakati: kuviunganisha vitu vyote katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, vitu vilivyo mbinguni na vitu vilivyo duniani, ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, \v 11 ambaye ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} pia tulifanywa urithi [wa Mungu], tukiisha kuamuliwa tangu awali kulingana na kusudi la yule anayetenda vitu vyote kulingana na uamuzi wa mapenzi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, \v 12 ili sisi, tuliokwisha kutumaini mapema katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, tuwe kwa sifa ya utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}};
sw.B: Ahimidiwe Mungu na Baba wa Bwana wetu Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}. Ndani ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} ametubariki kwa kila baraka itokayo kwa Roho katika ulimwengu wa mbinguni. \v 4 Hata kabla ulimwengu haujaumbwa, Mungu alituchagua ndani ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, ili tuwe watakatifu na bila dosari mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} katika upendo. \v 5 Alitutenga tangu awali tufanywe wana {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} kupitia Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}. Ndivyo alivyopenda kufanya kwa moyo mkunjufu, \v 6 ili neema {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} yenye utukufu isifiwe, neema ambayo ametupa bure katika yule Mpendwa. \v 7 Ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, na kupitia damu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, tuna ukombozi, msamaha wa makosa yetu. Tunao kwa sababu neema ya Mungu ni tele, \v 8 neema ambayo ameimimina juu yetu kwa wingi, pamoja na hekima yote na ufahamu. \v 9 Ametujulisha siri ya mapenzi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, kama ilivyompendeza kufanya. Aliweka kusudi hili ndani ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} \v 10 kuwa mpango {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} kwa wakati nyakati zitakapotimia: kuviunganisha vitu vyote chini ya kichwa kimoja ndani ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, vitu vya mbinguni na vitu vya duniani, vyote ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. \v 11 Ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} sisi pia tumefanywa fungu la Mungu mwenyewe. Tuliamuliwa kwa ajili ya jambo hili tangu awali kwa kusudi la Mungu, anayetenda kila kitu kama mapenzi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} yanavyoamua, \v 12 ili sisi, tuliokuwa wa kwanza kuweka tumaini letu katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, tuuletee utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} sifa.
sw.R: Tumsifu Mungu, Baba wa Bwana wetu Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}! Kwa sababu tumeunganishwa na {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, Mungu ametubariki kwa kila baraka ambayo Roho huleta, baraka kutoka mbinguni. \v 4 Hata kabla hajaumba ulimwengu, Mungu alituchagua tuunganishwe na {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}. Alituchagua tuwe watakatifu na bila kosa machoni {{deity_pronoun:pake|Pake}}, na tuishi kwa upendo. \v 5 Zamani sana Mungu aliamua kutufanya wana {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} kupitia Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, tukiwa na haki zote za watoto {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}. Ndivyo alivyotaka, na jambo hilo lilimfurahisha. \v 6 Alifanya hivyo ili neema {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} yenye utukufu isifiwe. Ametupa neema hii bure katika Mwana {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} mpendwa. \v 7 Kupitia damu ya Mwana {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} tumewekwa huru, na makosa yetu yamesamehewa. Ndivyo neema ya Mungu ilivyo tele, \v 8 naye ameimimina juu yetu kwa wingi. Ametupa hekima yote na ufahamu. \v 9 Ametujulisha siri ya kile alichotaka kufanya: mpango {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, uliokuwa umefichwa, sasa umejulishwa. Mungu alifurahi kufanya mpango huu, naye aliufanya ili utimizwe kupitia {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}. \v 10 Huu ndio mpango wa Mungu kwa wakati alioupanga: kuunganisha kila kitu kilicho mbinguni na duniani, {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} akiwa kichwa juu ya vyote. \v 11 Kwa sababu tumeunganishwa na {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, Mungu ametufanya watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} mwenyewe, fungu {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} la thamani. Aliamua hivyo zamani sana. Mungu hufanya kila kitu kitokee jinsi alivyopanga na kutaka. \v 12 Alifanya hivyo ili utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usifiwe kwa sababu yetu sisi, tuliokuwa wa kwanza kuweka tumaini letu katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}.

fr.L: Béni [soit] le Dieu et Père de notre Seigneur Jésus {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, qui nous a bénis de toute bénédiction spirituelle dans les [lieux] célestes {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}}, \v 4 selon qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} nous a choisis en {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} avant la fondation du monde, pour que nous soyons saints et sans tache devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} dans l’amour, \v 5 nous ayant prédestinés à l’adoption comme {{gender:fils et filles|fils}} par Jésus {{christos:Christ|Messie}} pour {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}}, selon le bon plaisir de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} volonté, \v 6 à [la] louange de [la] gloire de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} grâce, dont {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} nous a gratifiés dans le Bien-Aimé, \v 7 en qui nous avons la rédemption par {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} sang, le pardon des fautes, selon la richesse de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} grâce, \v 8 qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a fait abonder envers nous en toute sagesse et intelligence, \v 9 nous ayant fait connaître le mystère de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} volonté, selon {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} bon plaisir, qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} s’était proposé en {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} \v 10 pour [l’]administration de la plénitude des temps : réunir toutes choses sous un seul chef dans le {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, les choses dans les cieux et les choses sur la terre, en {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, \v 11 en qui aussi nous avons été faits [l’]héritage [de Dieu], ayant été prédestinés selon [le] dessein de celui qui opère toutes choses selon le conseil de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} volonté, \v 12 pour que nous soyons à [la] louange de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} gloire, nous qui avons d’avance espéré dans le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} ;
fr.B: Béni soit le Dieu et Père de notre Seigneur Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}}. {{christos:En Christ|Dans le Messie}}, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} nous a bénis de toutes les bénédictions que donne l’Esprit dans les lieux célestes. \v 4 Avant même la fondation du monde, Dieu nous a choisis {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}}, pour que nous soyons saints et sans tache devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} dans l’amour. \v 5 Il nous a destinés d’avance à être adoptés comme {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} propres {{gender:fils et filles|fils}} par Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}}. C’est ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a voulu, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’a voulu avec joie, \v 6 pour que soit louée {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} grâce glorieuse, la grâce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} nous a donnée gratuitement dans le Bien-Aimé. \v 7 En {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, par {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} sang, nous avons la rédemption, le pardon de nos fautes. Nous l’avons parce que la grâce de Dieu est si riche, \v 8 cette grâce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a répandue sur nous en abondance, avec toute sagesse et toute intelligence. \v 9 Il nous a fait connaître le mystère de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} volonté, comme il {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} a plu de le faire. Ce dessein, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’a établi {{christos:en Christ|dans le Messie}} \v 10 comme {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} plan pour le moment où les temps seraient accomplis : réunir toutes choses sous un seul chef, le {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, ce qui est dans le ciel et ce qui est sur la terre, tout en {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. \v 11 En {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, nous aussi, nous sommes devenus la part qui appartient à Dieu. Nous y avons été destinés d’avance par le dessein de Dieu, qui accomplit tout comme {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} volonté le décide, \v 12 afin que nous, les premiers à avoir espéré dans le {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, nous servions à la louange de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} gloire.
fr.R: Louons le Dieu et Père de notre Seigneur Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}} ! Parce que nous sommes unis au {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, Dieu nous a donné toutes les bénédictions que l’Esprit apporte, des bénédictions qui viennent du monde céleste. \v 4 Avant même de créer le monde, Dieu nous a choisis pour que nous soyons unis au {{christos:Christ|Messie}}. Il nous a choisis pour que nous soyons saints et sans défaut à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} yeux, et pour que nous vivions dans l’amour. \v 5 Il y a très longtemps, Dieu a décidé de nous adopter par Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}}, pour que nous soyons {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} propres {{gender:fils et filles|fils}}, avec tous les droits de {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} enfants. C’est ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} voulait, et cela {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} a donné de la joie. \v 6 Il l’a fait pour que tous louent {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} grâce glorieuse. Cette grâce, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} nous l’a donnée gratuitement par {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} Fils bien-aimé. \v 7 Par le sang de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} Fils, nous avons été libérés, et nos fautes sont pardonnées. Voilà combien la grâce de Dieu est riche ! \v 8 Il l’a répandue sur nous sans compter. Il nous a donné toute la sagesse et toute l’intelligence. \v 9 Il nous a fait connaître le mystère de ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} voulait faire : {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} plan, autrefois caché, maintenant révélé. Dieu a été heureux de former ce plan, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’a formé pour qu’il se réalise par le {{christos:Christ|Messie}}. \v 10 Voici le plan de Dieu pour le moment qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a fixé : réunir tout ce qui est dans le ciel et sur la terre, avec le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} comme chef de tout. \v 11 Parce que nous sommes unis au {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, Dieu a fait de nous {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} propre peuple, {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} part précieuse. Il l’avait décidé bien avant. Dieu fait tout arriver comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’a prévu et voulu. \v 12 Il l’a fait pour que nous, les premiers à mettre notre espérance dans le {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, nous fassions louer {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} gloire.

decisions.choice: blessed be God: the Jewish form of praise that blesses God for what he has done
alternatives: a statement that God is blessed, with no call to praise
decisions.reason: Jewish prayer praised God with "Blessed be the Lord" (Psalm 41:14; 72:18), and Paul opens 2 Corinthians 1:3 the same way, as does 1 Peter 1:3. Paul plays on the word: Εὐλογητὸς, εὐλογήσας, εὐλογίᾳ. God is blessed (praised) because he has blessed his people. The Greek has no verb, so the line can be a wish ("blessed be") or a statement ("blessed is"); in this form of prayer the two come to the same thing.

decisions.choice: verses 3-14 are one long act of praise; the refrain "to the praise of his glory" marks its movements
decisions.reason: In Greek the praise runs from verse 3 to verse 14 as one sentence; the SBLGNT marks a pause at the end of verse 12, and this record follows it. The refrain comes three times (verses 6, 12 and 14): after the Father's choosing and adopting (verses 4-6), after the plan carried out in Christ (verses 7-12), and after the sealing with the Spirit (verses 13-14).

decisions.choice: spiritual: given by the Spirit
decisions.reason: Paul uses πνευματικῇ of what comes from the Spirit of God (1 Corinthians 2:13-15; Colossians 1:9), and the Spirit is named in verses 13-14 as the seal and pledge of these blessings.

decisions.choice: in the heavenly places: the realm of heaven, where Christ now reigns
decisions.reason: ἐπουρανίοις is an adjective with no noun; in this letter it always names a place: where Christ is seated (1:20), where believers are seated with him (2:6), and where the rulers and authorities are (3:10; 6:12). The blessings belong to that realm, where Christ already reigns.

decisions.choice: in Christ: through union with Christ
alternatives: by means of Christ only, as an instrument
decisions.reason: "In Christ", "in him" and "in whom" run through verses 3-14 about a dozen times. Every gift is given to those joined to Christ, and comes through what he has done; both ideas are present, and the second does not replace the first.

decisions.choice: God chose his people in Christ before he created the world
decisions.reason: ἐξελέξατο means God picked out a people for himself, as he chose Israel (Deuteronomy 7:6-8). His choice came before creation ("before the foundation of the world", as John 17:24) and was made "in him", in Christ. Its goal follows: a holy people.

decisions.choice: holy and blameless: set apart for God and without blemish, like an offering fit to bring to him
decisions.reason: ἀμώμους is the word for animals without defect, fit for sacrifice (Exodus 29:1; Leviticus 1:3). Paul uses the pair of people brought before God (5:27; Colossians 1:22).

decisions.choice: "in love" goes with verse 4: holy and blameless before him in love
alternatives: "in love" begins verse 5: "in love he predestined us"
decisions.reason: The Greek has no punctuation, and ἐν ἀγάπῃ can end verse 4 or begin verse 5. The SBLGNT puts it with verse 4: the holy life God chose his people for is a life of love (compare 3:17; 4:2; 5:2). Read with verse 5, it would be God's love that moved him to adopt them. Both are true; the question is only which Paul says here.

decisions.choice: predestined: decided beforehand, marked out in advance for a goal
decisions.reason: προορίσας is made of "before" and "to mark out a boundary". The goal is named each time: adoption (verse 5), and bringing praise to God's glory (verses 11-12). Paul plays on the root again in verses 9 and 11 ("he purposed", "purpose").

decisions.choice: adoption as sons: being made God's children and heirs, with the full rights of a son
decisions.reason: υἱοθεσίαν is the legal term for adoption (Romans 8:15; Galatians 4:5). Under Roman law an adopted son took the family name and became his father's heir with full rights; the inheritance follows in verses 11 and 14. Women and men alike are meant: Paul quotes God's promise "you shall be my sons and daughters" (2 Corinthians 6:18) and says that in Christ there is neither male nor female (Galatians 3:26-29).

decisions.choice: to himself: God adopts them into his own family
decisions.reason: αὐτόν most naturally refers back to the subject, God the Father, who adopts them as his own children through Jesus Christ.

decisions.choice: the good pleasure of his will: what God freely chose and took delight in
decisions.reason: εὐδοκίαν is goodwill or delight. God was not forced to adopt his people or to reveal his plan; he willed it and was glad to do it. The phrase returns in verse 9, and "the counsel of his will" in verse 11.

decisions.choice: the glory of his grace: his glorious grace, which he freely gave
decisions.reason: Greek often uses "X of Y" to describe: "the glory of his grace" is his glorious grace. ἐχαρίτωσεν is a verb from the same root as χάριτος: literally God "graced" his people, gave them his grace as a free gift (Luke 1:28 is the only other place it is used in the New Testament).

decisions.choice: the Beloved: a title for Christ, the one God loves
alternatives: any loved one, with no title intended
decisions.reason: ἠγαπημένῳ is a passive participle, "the one who has been loved". God calls Jesus his beloved Son at his baptism (Mark 1:11), and Colossians 1:13 speaks of "the Son of his love". In the Greek Old Testament the same word is used of Israel as God's loved people (Deuteronomy 33:5, 26; Isaiah 44:2), so it may also present Christ as the one in whom God's love for his people is gathered up.

decisions.choice: redemption: release, as of a slave or captive, at a cost; here, the forgiveness of trespasses, won by Christ's death
alternatives: a general deliverance with no idea of cost
decisions.reason: ἀπολύτρωσιν was used for setting a slave or prisoner free by payment of a price. Here the cost is Christ's blood, his violent death given as a sacrifice, and the release is explained as ἄφεσιν, the forgiveness of παραπτωμάτων, wrong steps. Colossians 1:14 says the same without "through his blood"; Ephesians 1:14 and 4:30 look forward to the final day of redemption.

decisions.choice: with all wisdom and insight: the grace God poured out brought his people all wisdom and understanding
alternatives: God acted with all wisdom and insight in pouring out his grace
with all wisdom and insight he made known the mystery (verse 9)
decisions.reason: ἐν φρονήσει could describe God's own wisdom or the wisdom given to his people. Paul elsewhere uses such words of what believers receive (Colossians 1:9), prays in verse 17 for the Spirit of wisdom, and the next words tell what they have come to know: the mystery of God's will. Since God himself is plainly wise, the difference is small.

decisions.choice: mystery: God's plan, hidden until he reveals it
decisions.reason: μυστήριον in Paul is not something hard to understand but something God kept hidden and has now made known (3:3-9; Colossians 1:26-27). Here its content follows in verse 10: all things brought together in Christ.

decisions.choice: a plan for the fullness of the times: God's ordering of history, carried out when the time he set has fully come
alternatives: a stewardship given to Paul (as in 3:2)
a final age only, not yet begun
decisions.reason: οἰκονομίαν is the management of a household, then any plan or ordering of affairs. Here the manager is God, and the plan concerns history reaching its full measure (compare Galatians 4:4, where "the fullness of the time" came when God sent his Son). The plan is already under way in Christ and moves toward its completion.

decisions.choice: to bring all things together into one in Christ, under him as head
alternatives: to sum up, as an argument is summed up
to restore all things to what they were
decisions.reason: ἀνακεφαλαιώσασθαι comes from the word for a main point or summary; Paul uses it in Romans 13:9 of the commandments summed up in one. Here all things, in heaven and on earth, are brought together into one whole in Christ. The word sounds like the word for "head", and Paul goes on to call Christ "head over all things" (1:22), so the thought of gathering everything under him as head is close at hand. How fully the word itself carries that sense is debated.

decisions.choice: we were made God's own portion, his inheritance
alternatives: we received an inheritance, a share
we were chosen by lot, appointed
decisions.reason: ἐκληρώθημεν is a passive verb from the word for a lot or share. It can mean that God's people were given their share, or that they were made God's own share, as Israel was "the Lord's portion" (Deuteronomy 32:9). The second fits the passive form and the letter's own words: God's "inheritance in the holy ones" (1:18) and his "possession" (1:14). Colossians 1:12 speaks of believers' share in the inheritance, which is the other side of the same truth.

decisions.choice: "we who first hoped in the Christ": Paul and his fellow Jewish believers, who hoped in the Messiah before the Gentile readers did; "you also" in verse 13 turns to the Gentiles
alternatives: "we" is all believers, who hope in Christ ahead of the final day of redemption
"we" is the first generation of believers, Jewish and Gentile
decisions.reason: προηλπικότας means "having hoped beforehand". Through verses 3-10 "we" means all believers. But here Paul says "we" hoped first, in "the Christ", with the article, the Messiah Israel awaited, and verse 13 begins καὶ ὑμεῖς, "you also". Chapter 2 is about Gentiles and Jews brought into one people (2:11-22). On the other reading, "beforehand" means before the hope is fulfilled, and there is no contrast between two groups. Either way verse 14 ends with "our inheritance", shared by all.

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} (L), with "the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}" where the Greek has the article; {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: Title setting. In verse 12 the article and the hope of Israel point toward the title "Messiah" (m21); the setting lets readers choose.

decisions.choice: adoption as {{gender:sons and daughters|sons}}
decisions.reason: The word means adoption as a son, with an heir's rights (m10), and women are included. "Children" would lose the heir's standing that the word carries; "sons and daughters" keeps it and is Paul's own phrase (2 Corinthians 6:18). "Sons" stays available as the traditional form.

decisions.choice: God chose us in {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}; He set out this purpose in {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}; the purpose of God
alternatives: he chose us in him; which he purposed in him; the purpose of the one who works all things
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name God and Christ where the Greek has only "he" and "him", since in English the two pronouns side by side would be unclear.

decisions.choice: every blessing the Spirit gives (B); every blessing the Spirit brings (R)
decisions.reason: "Spiritual" in current English often means inward or religious; Balanced and Readable say whose gift these blessings are (m3).

decisions.choice: blessings from the heavenly world
decisions.reason: Readable uses the plainer phrase from the Ephesians word list; the sense is the realm where Christ reigns (m4).

decisions.choice: Because we are joined to {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}; God chose us to be joined to {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}
decisions.reason: Readable explains "in Christ" as being joined to him (m5). "Because" states the link that "in Christ" implies here: the blessings come to those who belong to him.

decisions.choice: with all the rights of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} children
alternatives: as his own sons and daughters
decisions.reason: Readable says what adoption meant in Paul's world: full standing as an heir (m10).

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} dearly loved Son
decisions.reason: Readable says who "the Beloved" is (m14) and uses "dearly loved" from the Ephesians word list.

decisions.choice: we have been set free
decisions.reason: "Redemption" is church language for many readers; Readable says what it means (m15), as Colossians 1:14 does.

decisions.choice: our wrongdoing (B); our wrongs (R)
decisions.reason: παραπτωμάτων means false steps, wrong acts. "Trespass" now usually means entering someone's land; "wrongdoing" keeps the sense of wrong deeds. Literal keeps "trespasses".

decisions.choice: claimed as God's own portion (B); {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own people, {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} treasured share (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable state the sense chosen in m20. Literal says "made [God's] inheritance".

decisions.choice: Praise the God and Father
alternatives: Blessed be the God and Father
decisions.reason: "Blessed be" is no longer everyday English; Readable says what it means: a call to praise God (m1).

decisions.choice: to bring all things together under one head
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps both parts of the sense chosen in m19: gathering into one, with Christ as head.

decisions.choice: hijos, no gender setting
decisions.reason: The English offers "sons and daughters" with "sons" as the traditional form. Spanish "hijos" already covers sons and daughters and keeps the heir's standing that adoption carries (m10), so, as with "hermanos" in Philippians 4:1, no setting is needed.

decisions.choice: ¡Alabemos al Dios y Padre ...!
alternatives: Alabado sea el Dios y Padre
decisions.reason: The English Readable turns "Blessed be" into a call to praise. A Spanish command would have to choose between "alaben" and "alabad"; "alabemos" (let us praise) is plain, includes Paul with his readers, and needs no ustedes/vosotros setting.

decisions.choice: {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}, {{christos:a Cristo|al Mesías}}
decisions.reason: With the title "el Mesías" Spanish contracts "de el" and "a el" to "del" and "al", so the span takes in the preposition wherever one comes before it.

decisions.choice: siri (every level; Readable explains)
decisions.reason: Swahili has one word for secret and mystery. Paul's "mystery" is a plan God kept hidden and has now made known (m17), which "siri" says well once the sentence says it has been revealed ("ametujulisha siri"). "Fumbo" is a riddle or puzzle, something hard to understand, which is not Paul's sense. Readable adds "uliokuwa umefichwa, sasa umejulishwa" as the English Readable does. For the whole letter.

decisions.choice: [mahali pa] mbinguni (L); ulimwengu wa mbinguni (B); mbinguni (R)
decisions.reason: The heavenly places are the realm where Christ reigns (m4) and where believers are seated with him (2:6). "Ulimwengu wa roho" (the spirit world) suits the powers of 6:12 but less well Christ's throne in 1:20; "mbinguni" (in heaven) names the place plainly. For the whole letter; for review by a native speaker.

decisions.choice: wana, no gender setting
decisions.reason: "Kufanywa wana" is adoption as children with an heir's standing (m10), and "wana" already includes sons and daughters. A male-only alternative would change the meaning, so the Swahili has no gender span here.

decisions.choice: Tumsifu Mungu (let us praise God)
decisions.reason: The English Readable makes "Blessed be" a call to praise. "Tumsifu" says it in everyday Swahili and includes Paul with his readers; "Ahimidiwe" (may he be praised) is kept for Balanced.

decisions.choice: the deity_pronoun span on every French pronoun for God or Christ, subject "il" and elided "l'" included, and on "lui" for the Holy Spirit (for the whole letter)
decisions.reason: As in Colossians and Hebrews: French must write the subject pronoun, so "il" for God or Christ carries the span wherever the English "he" does, and also where French needs a pronoun the English lacks ("qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}}", "{{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a ressuscité"). The Holy Spirit is "il", never "it"; the relative "qui" takes no span.

decisions.choice: dans les [lieux] célestes (L); dans les lieux célestes (B); le monde céleste, le ciel (R) (for the whole letter, 1:3, 1:20, 2:6, 3:10, 6:12)
alternatives: dans le ciel at every level
decisions.reason: The Greek is an adjective, "the heavenly [ones]", with no noun (m4). Literal brackets the noun French needs; Balanced keeps "les lieux célestes" so the phrase can be traced through the letter; Readable says plainly where it is.

decisions.choice: l’adoption comme {{gender:fils et filles|fils}} (L); adoptés comme {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} propres {{gender:fils et filles|fils}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in English: the word is adoption as a son and heir (m10), and women are included. "Enfants" would lose the heir's standing; "fils" alone remains as the traditional form.

decisions.choice: prédestinés (L), destinés d’avance (B), a décidé (R); réunir toutes choses sous un seul chef (L, B)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the traditional "prédestiner", built like the Greek verb "mark out beforehand" (m9); Balanced says the same in current words. For the verb of verse 10, "récapituler" now means "summarize" in French; "réunir sous un seul chef" keeps both parts of the sense, gathering and the head (m19).

source.text: ἐν ᾧ καὶ ὑμεῖς ἀκούσαντες τὸν λόγον τῆς ἀληθείας, τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τῆς σωτηρίας ὑμῶν, ἐν ᾧ καὶ πιστεύσαντες ἐσφραγίσθητε τῷ πνεύματι τῆς ἐπαγγελίας τῷ ἁγίῳ, ὅ ἐστιν ἀρραβὼν τῆς κληρονομίας ἡμῶν, εἰς ἀπολύτρωσιν τῆς περιποιήσεως, εἰς ἔπαινον τῆς δόξης αὐτοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: In whom also you, having heard the word of the truth, the gospel of the salvation of you, in whom also having believed you were sealed with the Spirit of the promise the Holy, \v 14 which is [the] pledge of the inheritance of us, for [the] redemption of the possession, for [the] praise of the glory of him.

en.L: In {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} you also, having heard the word of the truth, the gospel of your salvation, in {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} also, having believed, you were sealed with the Holy Spirit of the promise, \v 14 who is [the] down payment of our inheritance, for [the] redemption of [God's own] possession, to [the] praise of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} glory.
en.B: And you also are in {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. You heard the message of truth, the gospel that brings you salvation, and you believed; and in {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} you were sealed with the Holy Spirit God had promised. \v 14 The Spirit is the down payment on our inheritance, until God redeems those who are {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own possession, so that {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} glory will be praised.
en.R: You also are joined to {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}. You heard the message of truth, the good news that God saves you. When you believed it, God put {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} seal on you: {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gave you the Holy Spirit {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had promised. This seal shows that you belong to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. \v 14 The Spirit is like a first payment that guarantees the rest. God will give us everything {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has promised. The day is coming when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will set free completely the people who are {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own. Then {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} glory will be praised.

es.L: En {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} también {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, habiendo oído la palabra de la verdad, el evangelio de {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} salvación, en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} también, habiendo creído, {{plural_you:fueron|fuisteis}} sellados con el Espíritu Santo de la promesa, \v 14 que es anticipo de nuestra herencia, para [la] redención de la posesión [de Dios], para alabanza de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gloria.
es.B: Y también {{plural_you:ustedes están|vosotros estáis}} en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. {{plural_you:Oyeron|Oísteis}} el mensaje de la verdad, el evangelio que {{plural_you:les|os}} trae salvación, y {{plural_you:creyeron|creísteis}}; y en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} {{plural_you:fueron|fuisteis}} sellados con el Espíritu Santo que Dios había prometido. \v 14 El Espíritu es el anticipo de nuestra herencia, hasta que Dios redima a los que son {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} propia posesión, para que {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gloria sea alabada.
es.R: También {{plural_you:ustedes están|vosotros estáis}} unidos {{christos:a Cristo|al Mesías}}. {{plural_you:Oyeron|Oísteis}} el mensaje de la verdad, la buena noticia de que Dios {{plural_you:los|os}} salva. Cuando lo {{plural_you:creyeron|creísteis}}, Dios {{plural_you:les|os}} puso {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} sello: {{plural_you:les|os}} dio el Espíritu Santo que había prometido. Ese sello muestra que {{plural_you:son|sois}} de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. \v 14 El Espíritu es como un primer pago que garantiza el resto. Dios nos dará todo lo que ha prometido. Viene el día en que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} liberará por completo a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} propio pueblo. Entonces {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gloria será alabada.

sw.L: Ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} ninyi pia, mliposikia neno la kweli, Injili ya wokovu wenu, ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} pia, mlipoamini, mlitiwa muhuri kwa Roho Mtakatifu wa ahadi, \v 14 ambaye ni malipo ya awali ya urithi wetu, kwa ukombozi wa mali [ya Mungu], kwa sifa ya utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.
sw.B: Nanyi pia mko ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. Mlisikia ujumbe wa kweli, Injili inayowaletea wokovu, mkaamini; na ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} mlitiwa muhuri kwa Roho Mtakatifu ambaye Mungu alikuwa ameahidi. \v 14 Roho ndiye malipo ya awali ya urithi wetu, mpaka Mungu atakapowakomboa wale walio mali {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, ili utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usifiwe.
sw.R: Ninyi pia mmeunganishwa na {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}. Mlisikia ujumbe wa kweli, Habari Njema kwamba Mungu anawaokoa. Mlipoiamini, Mungu aliweka muhuri {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} juu yenu: aliwapa Roho Mtakatifu aliyekuwa ameahidi. Muhuri huu unaonyesha kwamba ninyi ni mali {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. \v 14 Roho ni kama malipo ya kwanza yanayohakikisha kwamba yaliyobaki yatakuja. Mungu atatupa kila kitu alichoahidi. Siku inakuja ambapo atawaweka huru kabisa watu walio mali {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. Hapo ndipo utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} utasifiwa.

fr.L: En {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} vous aussi, ayant entendu la parole de la vérité, l’Évangile de votre salut, en {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} aussi, ayant cru, vous avez été scellés de l’Esprit Saint de la promesse, \v 14 qui est [l’]acompte de notre héritage, pour [la] rédemption de [ce que Dieu s’est] acquis, à [la] louange de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} gloire.
fr.B: Vous aussi, vous êtes en {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. Vous avez entendu le message de la vérité, l’Évangile qui vous apporte le salut, et vous avez cru ; et en {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} vous avez été marqués du sceau de l’Esprit Saint que Dieu avait promis. \v 14 L’Esprit est l’acompte de notre héritage, en attendant que Dieu rachète pleinement ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} appartiennent, pour que {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} gloire soit louée.
fr.R: Vous aussi, vous êtes unis au {{christos:Christ|Messie}}. Vous avez entendu le message de la vérité, la bonne nouvelle que Dieu vous sauve. Quand vous y avez cru, Dieu a mis {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} marque sur vous : {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vous a donné l’Esprit Saint qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} avait promis. Cette marque montre que vous {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} appartenez. \v 14 L’Esprit est comme un premier versement qui garantit le reste : Dieu nous donnera tout ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a promis. Le jour vient où {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} libérera complètement ceux qui sont {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple. Alors {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} gloire sera louée.

decisions.choice: the praise of verses 3-12 goes on: "in whom" is Christ, and the refrain closes it a third time
alternatives: a new sentence with a new subject
decisions.reason: The SBLGNT marks a pause after verse 12, but ἐν ᾧ picks up "in the Christ" from the end of verse 12, and "to the praise of his glory" ends the whole passage as it ended verses 6 and 12.

decisions.choice: "you also": the Gentile readers, who have come to share what "we" have; "our inheritance" joins both
alternatives: "you" and "we" are the same people, with no contrast
decisions.reason: καὶ ὑμεῖς sets the readers beside the "we" of verses 11-12 (see the note there). Verse 14 then speaks of "our" inheritance, which Jews and Gentiles share alike, as 2:11-22 and 3:6 say at length.

decisions.choice: the sentence starts again with a second "in whom"; the main verb is "you were sealed"
alternatives: "having believed in him" (Christ as the one believed in)
decisions.reason: After ὑμεῖς ἀκούσαντες the sentence breaks off and resumes with ἐν ᾧ. The main verb, ἐσφραγίσθητε, comes only here: in Christ, when they believed, they were sealed.

decisions.choice: the word of the truth is the gospel that brings their salvation
alternatives: a true word that belongs to the gospel
decisions.reason: The two phrases describe one message, as in Colossians 1:5: the message is the truth, and that message is the gospel that saves them.

decisions.choice: sealed: marked as God's own and kept safe
decisions.reason: A seal pressed in wax marked a document or goods as belonging to their owner and kept them from tampering. ἐσφραγίσθητε says God has marked believers as his by giving them the Spirit (4:30; 2 Corinthians 1:22).

decisions.choice: the Spirit of the promise: the Holy Spirit whom God promised through the prophets and through Jesus
decisions.reason: God promised to pour out his Spirit and put it within his people (Joel 2:28-29; Ezekiel 36:26-27); Jesus spoke of "the promise of the Father" (Acts 1:4; 2:33), and Paul says the Gentiles too receive the promised Spirit through faith (Galatians 3:14).

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: ὅ, a neuter "which", agreeing with "Spirit"
decisions.reason: Manuscripts differ between the neuter and the masculine form of the relative pronoun. Both refer to the Holy Spirit, and the meaning does not change. Reviewers should check the evidence against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: down payment: a first installment that guarantees the full payment will follow
alternatives: a pledge given as security and later returned
decisions.reason: ἀρραβὼν is a trade word, borrowed from Hebrew, for money paid at the start of a deal to bind the buyer to pay the rest. The Spirit is both part of the inheritance, already given, and God's guarantee that the rest will come (2 Corinthians 1:22; 5:5).

decisions.choice: the redemption of God's own possession: the day God sets his people fully free
alternatives: until we take possession of our inheritance
decisions.reason: περιποιήσεως means something acquired and kept as one's own. In the Old Testament God's people are his treasured possession (Exodus 19:5), and the Greek Old Testament uses this word for them in Malachi 3:17, and 1 Peter 2:9 calls the church "a people for his possession". It could instead mean the believers' coming into possession of the inheritance. Either way, the redemption here is the final one, still ahead (4:30).

decisions.choice: who
decisions.reason: The pronoun refers to the Holy Spirit; English does not call the Spirit "which" or "it", whatever the Greek gender of the word.

decisions.choice: down payment
decisions.reason: "Down payment" keeps the trade picture and its point: part now, the rest to come (m8). "Guarantee" keeps only the second half; "deposit" can suggest money that will be returned.

decisions.choice: This seal shows that you belong to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}; a first payment that guarantees the rest. God will give us everything {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has promised
alternatives: you were sealed; the down payment on our inheritance
decisions.reason: Readable explains the two pictures, the seal (m5) and the down payment (m8), and says what "our inheritance" is, using the wording of the Ephesians word list.

decisions.choice: until God redeems those who are {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own possession (B); when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will set free completely the people who are {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own (R)
alternatives: for the redemption of the possession
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable state the sense chosen in m9. Readable uses "set free" for redemption, as in verse 7.

decisions.choice: You also are joined to {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}
decisions.reason: Readable names Christ and explains "in him", as in verses 3-12.

decisions.choice: anticipo (L, B); un primer pago que garantiza el resto (R)
decisions.reason: "Arras" is the traditional term but today mostly names the coins of a wedding rite or a legal deposit; "garantía" keeps only the promise. "Anticipo" is a part paid now with the rest to follow, the trade picture of m8.

decisions.choice: malipo ya awali (L, B); malipo ya kwanza yanayohakikisha kwamba yaliyobaki yatakuja (R)
decisions.reason: "Arabuni" is the borrowed trade word but few readers know it today; "dhamana" (guarantee, security) keeps only the promise. "Malipo ya awali" (first payment) says part is paid now and the rest will follow (m8).

decisions.choice: l’acompte (L, B); un premier versement qui garantit le reste (R)
decisions.reason: "Acompte" is the French trade word for a first part of a price that commits the buyer to pay the rest, which is the picture (m8). "Gage" and "garantie" keep only the promise; "arrhes" can be forfeited, which is not the point.

decisions.choice: scellés (L); marqués du sceau (B); a mis {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} marque (R)
decisions.reason: French "sceller" today mostly means to fix in place or to close a letter; Balanced names the seal itself, a mark of ownership and protection (m5), and Readable says "marque" and what it shows.

source.text: Διὰ τοῦτο κἀγώ, ἀκούσας τὴν καθ’ ὑμᾶς πίστιν ἐν τῷ κυρίῳ Ἰησοῦ καὶ τὴν ἀγάπην τὴν εἰς πάντας τοὺς ἁγίους, οὐ παύομαι εὐχαριστῶν ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν μνείαν ποιούμενος ἐπὶ τῶν προσευχῶν μου, ἵνα ὁ θεὸς τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, ὁ πατὴρ τῆς δόξης, δώῃ ὑμῖν πνεῦμα σοφίας καὶ ἀποκαλύψεως ἐν ἐπιγνώσει αὐτοῦ, πεφωτισμένους τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς τῆς καρδίας ὑμῶν εἰς τὸ εἰδέναι ὑμᾶς τίς ἐστιν ἡ ἐλπὶς τῆς κλήσεως αὐτοῦ, τίς ὁ πλοῦτος τῆς δόξης τῆς κληρονομίας αὐτοῦ ἐν τοῖς ἁγίοις, καὶ τί τὸ ὑπερβάλλον μέγεθος τῆς δυνάμεως αὐτοῦ εἰς ἡμᾶς τοὺς πιστεύοντας κατὰ τὴν ἐνέργειαν τοῦ κράτους τῆς ἰσχύος αὐτοῦ ἣν ἐνήργηκεν ἐν τῷ Χριστῷ ἐγείρας αὐτὸν ἐκ νεκρῶν, καὶ καθίσας ἐν δεξιᾷ αὐτοῦ ἐν τοῖς ἐπουρανίοις ὑπεράνω πάσης ἀρχῆς καὶ ἐξουσίας καὶ δυνάμεως καὶ κυριότητος καὶ παντὸς ὀνόματος ὀνομαζομένου οὐ μόνον ἐν τῷ αἰῶνι τούτῳ ἀλλὰ καὶ ἐν τῷ μέλλοντι·

records.literal_gloss: Because of this I also, having heard of the among you faith in the Lord Jesus and the love the [love] toward all the holy [ones], \v 16 do not cease giving thanks for you, mention making at the prayers of me, \v 17 that the God of the Lord of us Jesus Christ, the Father of the glory, may give to you [a] spirit of wisdom and revelation in knowledge of him, \v 18 having been enlightened the eyes of the heart of you, for the to know you what is the hope of the calling of him, what the riches of the glory of the inheritance of him in the holy [ones], \v 19 and what the surpassing greatness of the power of him toward us the [ones] believing according to the working of the might of the strength of him, \v 20 which he worked in the Christ, having raised him from [the] dead and having seated [him] at [the] right [hand] of him in the heavenly [places], \v 21 above every rule and authority and power and lordship and every name being named, not only in the age this but also in the [one] coming;

en.L: Because of this I also, having heard of the faith in the Lord Jesus [that is] among you and the love [you have] for all the holy ones, \v 16 do not stop giving thanks for you, making mention [of you] in my prayers, \v 17 that the God of our Lord Jesus {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}, the Father of glory, may give you [the] Spirit of wisdom and revelation in [the] knowledge of {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, \v 18 the eyes of your heart having been enlightened, so that you may know what is the hope of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} calling, what [are] the riches of the glory of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} inheritance in the holy ones, \v 19 and what [is] the surpassing greatness of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} power toward us who believe, according to the working of the might of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} strength, \v 20 which {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} worked in the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}, having raised {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} from [the] dead and seated [{{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}] at {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} right [hand] in the heavenly [places], \v 21 far above every rule and authority and power and lordship and every name that is named, not only in this age but also in the [one] to come;
en.B: For this reason, since I heard of your faith in the Lord Jesus and your love for all God's holy people, \v 16 I have never stopped thanking God for you. I mention you whenever I pray, \v 17 asking the God of our Lord Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, the Father of glory, to give you the Spirit who brings wisdom and revelation as you come to know {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. \v 18 With the eyes of your heart opened to the light, you will know what hope {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} call holds out to you, how rich and glorious an inheritance {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy people, \v 19 and how far beyond all measure is {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} power at work for us who believe. It is the working of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} mighty strength, \v 20 which {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} put to work in {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} raised {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} from the dead and set {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} at {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} right hand in the heavenly places, \v 21 high above every ruler and authority, every power and dominion, and every name that can be named, not only in this age but in the age to come as well.
en.R: That is why, ever since I heard about your faith in the Lord Jesus and your love for all of God's people, \v 16 I have not stopped thanking God for you. I keep remembering you when I pray. \v 17 I ask the God of our Lord Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, the glorious Father, to give you {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} Spirit, who makes you wise and shows you what God is like, so that you will truly know {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. \v 18 I ask {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to open the eyes of your heart and fill them with light, so that you will understand three things. You will know the hope {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gave you when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} called you. You will know how glorious and precious {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy people are to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}: they are {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own treasured inheritance. \v 19 And you will know how great {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} power is for us who believe. Nothing can compare with it. It is the same mighty strength \v 20 that God used when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} raised {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} from the dead. God gave {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} the place of honor at {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} right hand in heaven. \v 21 There {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} is far above every ruler and authority, every power and lord, and every name anyone can call on. He is above them, not only in this age but also in the age to come.

es.L: Por esto yo también, habiendo oído de la fe en el Señor Jesús [que hay] entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} y del amor [que {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}}] por todos los santos, \v 16 no dejo de dar gracias por {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, haciendo mención [de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}] en mis oraciones, \v 17 para que el Dios de nuestro Señor Jesús {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}}, el Padre de la gloria, {{plural_you:les|os}} dé [el] Espíritu de sabiduría y de revelación en [el] conocimiento de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, \v 18 habiendo sido iluminados los ojos de {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} corazón, para que {{plural_you:sepan|sepáis}} cuál es la esperanza de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} llamamiento, cuáles [son] las riquezas de la gloria de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} herencia en los santos, \v 19 y cuál [es] la incomparable grandeza de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} poder hacia nosotros los que creemos, según la acción del poderío de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} fuerza, \v 20 que obró en el {{christos:Cristo|Mesías}}, resucitándolo de [entre los] muertos y sentándolo a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} derecha en los [lugares] celestiales, \v 21 muy por encima de todo gobierno y autoridad y poder y señorío y de todo nombre que se nombra, no solo en esta era sino también en la venidera;
es.B: Por esta razón, desde que oí de la fe que {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}} en el Señor Jesús y del amor que {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}} por todo el pueblo santo de Dios, \v 16 no he dejado de dar gracias a Dios por {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. {{plural_you:Los|Os}} menciono siempre que oro, \v 17 y pido al Dios de nuestro Señor Jesús {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}}, el Padre de la gloria, que {{plural_you:les|os}} dé el Espíritu que trae sabiduría y revelación, para que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} {{plural_you:conozcan|conozcáis}} cada vez más. \v 18 Con los ojos de {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} corazón abiertos a la luz, {{plural_you:sabrán|sabréis}} qué esperanza {{plural_you:les|os}} ofrece {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} llamado, cuán rica y gloriosa es la herencia que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} tiene en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo santo, \v 19 y cuán inmensamente grande es {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} poder, que actúa a favor de nosotros los que creemos. Es la acción de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} poderosa fuerza, \v 20 que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} puso en acción en {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} cuando {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} resucitó de entre los muertos y {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} sentó a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} derecha en los lugares celestiales, \v 21 muy por encima de todo gobernante y autoridad, de todo poder y dominio, y de todo nombre que pueda nombrarse, no solo en esta era sino también en la era venidera.
es.R: Por eso, desde que supe de la fe que {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}} en el Señor Jesús y del amor que {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}} por todo el pueblo de Dios, \v 16 no he dejado de dar gracias a Dios por {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. Siempre {{plural_you:los|os}} recuerdo cuando oro. \v 17 Pido al Dios de nuestro Señor Jesús {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}}, el Padre glorioso, que {{plural_you:les|os}} dé {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} Espíritu, que {{plural_you:los|os}} hace sabios y {{plural_you:les|os}} muestra cómo es Dios, para que de verdad {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} {{plural_you:conozcan|conozcáis}}. \v 18 Pido que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} abra los ojos de {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} corazón y los llene de luz, para que {{plural_you:entiendan|entendáis}} tres cosas. {{plural_you:Sabrán|Sabréis}} cuál es la esperanza que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} {{plural_you:les|os}} dio cuando {{plural_you:los|os}} llamó. {{plural_you:Sabrán|Sabréis}} cuán glorioso y valioso es para {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo santo: es {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} propia herencia preciosa. \v 19 Y {{plural_you:sabrán|sabréis}} cuán grande es {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} poder para nosotros los que creemos. Nada se puede comparar con él. Es la misma fuerza poderosa \v 20 que Dios usó cuando resucitó {{christos:a Cristo|al Mesías}} de entre los muertos. Dios {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} dio el lugar de honor a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} derecha en el cielo. \v 21 Allí {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} está muy por encima de todo gobernante y autoridad, de todo poder y señor, y de todo nombre que alguien pueda invocar. Está por encima de ellos, no solo en esta era sino también en la era venidera.

sw.L: Kwa sababu hii mimi pia, nikiisha kusikia habari ya imani katika Bwana Yesu [iliyo] kwenu na upendo [mlio nao] kwa watakatifu wote, \v 16 siachi kushukuru kwa ajili yenu, nikiwataja katika maombi yangu, \v 17 ili Mungu wa Bwana wetu Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, Baba wa utukufu, awape Roho wa hekima na wa ufunuo katika kumjua {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}, \v 18 macho ya moyo wenu yakiwa yametiwa nuru, ili mjue tumaini la wito {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} ni nini, utajiri wa utukufu wa urithi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} katika watakatifu ni nini, \v 19 na ukubwa upitao kiasi wa uweza {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} kwetu sisi tunaoamini ni nini, kulingana na utendaji wa ukuu wa nguvu {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}, \v 20 alioutenda katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, akimfufua kutoka kwa wafu na akimketisha upande {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wa kulia katika [mahali pa] mbinguni, \v 21 juu sana ya kila utawala na mamlaka na uweza na ubwana na kila jina litajwalo, si katika enzi hii tu bali pia katika ile ijayo;
sw.B: Kwa sababu hiyo, tangu niliposikia habari za imani yenu katika Bwana Yesu na upendo wenu kwa watu wote wa Mungu walio watakatifu, \v 16 sijaacha kumshukuru Mungu kwa ajili yenu. Ninawataja kila ninaposali, \v 17 nikimwomba Mungu wa Bwana wetu Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, Baba wa utukufu, awape Roho aletaye hekima na ufunuo mnapozidi kumjua. \v 18 Macho ya moyo wenu yakiwa yamefunguliwa kwa nuru, mtajua tumaini ambalo wito {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} unawapa, jinsi urithi alio nao katika watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} watakatifu ulivyo tajiri na wenye utukufu, \v 19 na jinsi uweza {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} unaotenda kazi kwa ajili yetu sisi tunaoamini ulivyo mkuu kupita kipimo chochote. Ni utendaji wa nguvu {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} kuu, \v 20 ambazo alizitumia katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} alipomfufua kutoka kwa wafu na kumketisha upande {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wa kulia katika ulimwengu wa mbinguni, \v 21 juu sana ya kila mtawala na mamlaka, kila uweza na ubwana, na kila jina linaloweza kutajwa, si katika enzi hii tu bali pia katika enzi ijayo.
sw.R: Ndiyo sababu, tangu niliposikia juu ya imani yenu katika Bwana Yesu na upendo wenu kwa watu wote wa Mungu, \v 16 sijaacha kumshukuru Mungu kwa ajili yenu. Ninaendelea kuwakumbuka ninaposali. \v 17 Ninamwomba Mungu wa Bwana wetu Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, Baba mwenye utukufu, awape Roho {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, anayewapa hekima na kuwaonyesha jinsi Mungu alivyo, ili mpate kumjua {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} kweli. \v 18 Ninamwomba afungue macho ya moyo wenu na kuyajaza nuru, ili mwelewe mambo matatu. Mtajua tumaini alilowapa alipowaita. Mtajua jinsi watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} watakatifu walivyo na utukufu na thamani kubwa {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}: wao ni urithi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} mwenyewe anaouthamini. \v 19 Tena mtajua jinsi uweza {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} ulivyo mkuu kwa ajili yetu sisi tunaoamini. Hakuna kitu kinachoweza kulinganishwa nao. Ni nguvu zile zile kuu \v 20 ambazo Mungu alizitumia alipomfufua {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} kutoka kwa wafu. Mungu alimpa mahali pa heshima upande {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wa kulia mbinguni. \v 21 Huko {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} yuko juu sana ya kila mtawala na mamlaka, kila uweza na bwana, na kila jina ambalo watu wanaweza kuliitia. Yuko juu yao wote, si katika enzi hii tu bali pia katika enzi ijayo.

fr.L: C’est pourquoi moi aussi, ayant entendu parler de la foi au Seigneur Jésus [qui est] parmi vous et de l’amour [que vous avez] pour tous les saints, \v 16 je ne cesse pas de rendre grâce pour vous, faisant mention [de vous] dans mes prières, \v 17 afin que le Dieu de notre Seigneur Jésus {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, le Père de la gloire, vous donne [l’]Esprit de sagesse et de révélation dans [la] connaissance de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, \v 18 les yeux de votre cœur ayant été illuminés, pour que vous sachiez quelle est l’espérance de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} appel, quelle [est] la richesse de la gloire de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} héritage dans les saints, \v 19 et quelle [est] l’extraordinaire grandeur de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} puissance envers nous qui croyons, selon l’action du pouvoir de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} force, \v 20 qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a déployée dans le {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}ayant ressuscité d’entre les morts et fait asseoir à {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} droite dans les [lieux] célestes, \v 21 au-dessus de toute principauté et autorité et puissance et seigneurie et de tout nom qui se nomme, non seulement dans cet âge-ci, mais aussi dans celui qui vient ;
fr.B: C’est pourquoi, depuis que j’ai entendu parler de votre foi au Seigneur Jésus et de votre amour pour tout le peuple saint de Dieu, \v 16 je ne cesse de remercier Dieu pour vous. Je pense à vous chaque fois que je prie, \v 17 et je demande au Dieu de notre Seigneur Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}}, le Père de la gloire, de vous donner l’Esprit qui apporte la sagesse et la révélation, pour que vous {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} connaissiez. \v 18 Les yeux de votre cœur ouverts à la lumière, vous saurez quelle espérance {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} appel vous offre, quelle richesse et quelle gloire {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} possède en héritage dans {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple saint, \v 19 et combien {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} puissance, qui agit pour nous, les croyants, dépasse toute mesure.
